Cemetery Operators, Perpetual Care Trust Funds and Preneed Burial Contracts

law.catch_line: Exemption from levy, garnishment and distress
law.text: Any money, personal property or real property paid, delivered or conveyed subject to § 54.1-2325 shall be exempt from levy, garnishment or distress.
